title: Special Topics in Persian Studies; Performing the Middle East: History, Politics, and Aesthetics
description:
Cross-listed with THET408E and THET608E. Credit only granted for THET408E, PERS498R, or THET608E.

This seminar examines the evolving aesthetics, sociopolitical engagements, and transnational collaborations of theatre and performance in the Middle East. We explore theatrical experimentations and revised historiographies within shifting contexts and trajectories. Readings include historical texts, dramatic literature, and critical scholarship, complemented by archival materials and performance recordings.
